<!-- Thanks for contributing! Say what this changes, and which lesson it's for. -->

- [ ] My change stays in one lesson's folder and its screenshots, or only changes repo-wide files.
- [ ] The lesson still builds (`./mvnw test-compile`), and its challenge is still unsolved.
- [ ] The lesson's `README.md` and `SOLUTION.md` still match.
- [ ] New screenshots don't show personal information, such as names, user names or email addresses.
